_comment: Frozen fixture data (SS8.1 of doc/experiment-minimum-context.md). Product personas map 1:1 onto the five NLBSE'24 repos, deterministically, alphabetically by repo full name. The mapping and the real repo name are NEVER shown to the model -- only the product persona below. The mapping itself is used offline by build_queues.py / expectations generation to compute ground truth, and by hydrate.py to check the model's classification against it.

products.name: Solidus
products.persona: a cryptocurrency full-node and wallet client: consensus rules, peer-to-peer networking, transaction relay, wallet key management.

products.name: Lucent
products.persona: a JavaScript library for building user interfaces: component rendering, the virtual DOM, hooks, server-side rendering.

products.name: Meridian
products.persona: a cross-platform source code editor: the text-editing core, extensions/plugins, debugging integration, the integrated terminal.

products.name: Aperture
products.persona: a computer-vision and image-processing library: image I/O, filters and transforms, camera calibration, video analysis.

products.name: Tensora
products.persona: a machine-learning framework: tensor operations, automatic differentiation, model training and serving, GPU/accelerator support.

_comment_hours: Deterministic lookup, intent x product -> hours. Supplied to the model as-is (not estimated). QUESTION is always cheap (answer, no code change). FEATURE > BUG for every product (new capability costs more than a fix). P1/P4/P5 (systems / numerical libraries) cost slightly more than P2/P3 (application-level libraries) for the same intent -- a fixed, arbitrary-but-frozen asymmetry so the lookup is not trivially uniform.
